name: Vibe Kanban
title: Ninebrains vs Vibe Kanban
description: Looking at Vibe Kanban, or for an alternative now that its company has shut down? How it compares with Ninebrains on planning, isolation, checks and maintenance.
summary: Kanban planning for 10+ agents. Company shut down; now community-maintained.
answer: Vibe Kanban plans coding-agent work on a kanban board and runs each task in a workspace with its own branch, terminal and dev server. Its company, bloop, shut down in April 2026, and the project is now community-maintained. Choose it for kanban planning across many agents; choose Ninebrains for a dependency-aware job graph and checks that must pass before work counts as done.
note: Vibe Kanban’s own site says it is sunsetting: bloop, the company behind it, shut down on April 10, 2026, and the project continues as open source and community-maintained.

what.text: Kanban issues to plan work, and workspaces where coding agents execute it.

price.text: Paid subscriptions were ended and refunded when the company shut down.

agents.text: 10+ agents, including Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot, Amp, Cursor and OpenCode.

isolation.text: Each workspace gives an agent a branch, a terminal and a dev server.

planning.text: A kanban board to create, prioritise and assign issues. A dependency graph is not described.

verification.text: Review diffs and leave inline comments that go straight back to the agent.

telemetry.text: Optional PostHog analytics, off when no API key is set at build time.

chooseThem.text: You think in kanban cards and want to plan privately or with a team.
You want a built-in browser preview with devtools and device emulation.
You switch between many agents: it supports 10+.

chooseUs: You want a grid of lanes with each agent’s status driven by its own hooks, and a browser, editor and terminal per lane.
You want dependencies between jobs, so work is handed out as it unblocks.
You want completion blocked until configured checks pass, rather than review left until the end.
